title: Strawberry Lemonade with Fresh Berries
summary: A bright red lemonade made from strawberries macerated with sugar and lemon zest, mashed, strained and topped up with plenty of fresh lemon juice.

steps.title: Macerate
steps.text: Finely grate the zest of 2 lemons over the strawberries and sugar in a large bowl. Toss and leave for 45 minutes at room temperature, stirring now and then, until the sugar has melted into a red syrup. The zest adds lemon oil that juice alone cannot.

steps.title: Juice
steps.text: Meanwhile, juice the zested lemons and enough extra lemons to make 240 ml.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Crush the berries thoroughly with a potato masher. Stir in the lemon juice and 500 ml of the cold water until no grains of sugar remain.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Press everything through a fine sieve into the jug and discard the pulp. Stir in the remaining 900 ml of water, taste, and add a splash more water if it is too sharp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Chill, or pour straight over ice. Add lemon rounds and strawberry halves to the jug.

tips: Use very ripe, deep red strawberries for the best colour.
For a fizzy version, use 900 ml of cold soda water for the final top-up and serve straight away.
Taste before serving: lemons vary, so adjust with water or a little more juice.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Add the garnish just before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
